title: Agent Dispatch Watchman trigger environment v1
description: The allowlisted WATCHMAN_* environment variables Agent Dispatch reads from a trigger invocation (SRC-002). WATCHMAN_FILES_OVERFLOW is deliberately absent: E0-T5 refuted it (0/23 invocations); the overflow-class signal is the missing WATCHMAN_SINCE position (architecture watchman-integration §7). maxLength counts JSON string code points; the runtime parser enforces the bound as 4096 bytes and is the authority when the two differ.

WATCHMAN_SINCE.description: Previous position; absent on the first invocation after trigger definition, replacement, or watch re-creation.

WATCHMAN_CLOCK.description: Current batch position; opaque token, never parsed locally.

WATCHMAN_RELATIVE_ROOT.description: Parsed for diagnostics only since D-028: never a binding axis. Its presence fails binding validation as a stale relative-root trigger; the managed trigger never sets it because the watch root is the configured resource root itself.
